label: Commutator jet controls
title: Rule 54 retains branching jet fibers where Rule 30 has only phases
kind: Exact three-rule controls and bounded follow-up
summary: Rules 54 and 30 recover full source spatial entropy at GQR, just like Rule 110; additive Rule 90 has G=Q=R=0. But Rule 54's equal-jet source-pair graph still has four branching recurrent off-diagonal SCCs, and three survive through A5. Rule 30 has only periodic off-diagonal recurrent cycles by GQR.
takeaway: Full spatial entropy does not imply phase-only hidden fibers. The previously noticed equality of critical jet radius with longest surviving phase period is falsified by Rule 30.
